extraction_notes: The datasheet title is BSS138 N-CHANNEL MOSFET, Rev. 1.0, from Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.; all four pages were examined.

The supplied datasheet has no transfer-characteristics figure. Output, capacitance, gate-charge, on-resistance, and normalized on-resistance curves were read directly from the labeled traces in p. 3; points are direct graph reads and are not generated by interpolation from a device model.

The maximum-ratings table specifies VDSS = 50 V, VGS = +/-20 V, ID = 0.34 A at TA = 25 degC steady state and 0.272 A at TA = 70 degC steady state, IDM = 2.5 A, PD = 350 mW, TJ = -55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJA = 357 K/W.

The IDSS maximum is 0.5 uA at VDS = 50 V and VGS = 0 V. The gate-body leakage limits are +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-20 V and +/-50 nA at VGS = +/-10 V, both with VDS = 0 V. These fields have no dedicated properties in the supplied schema.

The dynamic-parameter table publishes Ciss = 17.5 pF typical and 60 pF maximum, Coss = 11.5 pF typical and 15 pF maximum, and Crss = 6.5 pF typical and 6.0 pF maximum at VDS = 25 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz. Values are transcribed in farads in specs.

The switching-parameter table publishes Qg = 1.7 nC, Qgs = 0.4 nC, Qgd = 0.224 nC, Qrr = 2.65 nC, and trr = 12.2 ns typical. Turn-on delay, rise time, turn-off delay, and fall time are 2.6 ns, 18.8 ns, 9.7 ns, and 47 ns typical at VDD = 25 V, VGS = 10 V, ID = 0.3 A, and RGEN = 6 ohm. The supplied schema has no dedicated fields for these quantities.
The body-diode continuous-current maximum is 0.34 A; no separate typical body-diode forward-voltage curve is provided, so body_diode uses the published 1.2 V maximum at IS = 0.3 A.

The safe-operating-area plot was examined but is not included as a model-fitting curve because the supplied schema has no dedicated SOA field. Package dimensions and ordering information are likewise outside the schema.
